thread:
jamie: heads-up — we're seeing a cascade: ArgoCD prune waves are deleting node-label-managers on the new gpu-node pools, Terraform remote state lock is stuck (DynamoDB) so autoscaler can't apply the scale-up plan, and pods are Pending. This started ~1945678700. Anyone else?

sahil: yep saw it. gpu-autoscaler failed with apply error referencing locked state. kubectl shows the new nodes are NotReady and kubelet evicting pods. :grimacing:

lucy: I can tail the ArgoCD controller logs. Could be prune window overlapping with our kubelet boot sequence. Can you paste the autoscaler error?

jamie: here's the terraform apply fail: ```Error: Error locking state: ConditionalCheckFailedException: The conditional request failed
on s3_backend.tf line 1, in resource "aws_dynamodb_table" "tf_state_lock":
``` and argo logs show `prune: deleted: daemonset/gpu-node-labeler` right after node creation.

dena: oof — the labeler DaemonSet is short-lived? it should be in the cluster-ops app (app-of-apps). If ArgoCD prunes it before node bootstrap finishes, labels never get applied, autoscaler taints/taint-manager mismatches. Suggest pausing prune for cluster-ops app.

sahil: can we pause the ArgoCD app from CLI? I can run: `argocd app set cluster-ops --sync-policy automated=false --prune=false` and then re-sync after.

lucy: before that, infra-bot, what's the current prune-wave schedule? infra-bot: Prune-wave scheduler: active window 02:00-04:00 UTC; next wave started at 1945678880. Currently running on 12 apps. :robot_face:

jamie: that aligns. We kicked an autoscale in that window. Plan: (1) pause prune on cluster-ops, (2) try to unlock terraform state (S3/DynamoDB), (3) rerun terraform apply for gpu pool, (4) re-enable prune.

dena: for the unlock: `aws dynamodb delete-item --table-name tf-locks --key '{"LockID": {"S": "default"}}'` — but be careful, only do if no other apply in progress. I'll check CI.

sahil: CI shows no active runs against that state. I'll execute the delete now and re-run terraform apply.

jamie: also increase ArgoCD `prune.timeout` for the app-of-apps? right now it's 60s and seems tight for clusters with slow kubelets. Maybe 5m.

lucy: good call. configmap patch: ```kubectl -n argocd patch cm argocd-cm -p '{"data":{"timeout.reconcile.timeout":"5m"}}'``` but verify key name in our cluster (we have custom keys). I'll patch in a minute.

deploy-bot: [deploy] argocd:patch configmap argocd-cm by lucy at 1945679700 — succeeded :white_check_mark:

sahil: terraform unlock done, reapplying... `apply complete!` new gpu nodes are Ready.

jamie: confirmed GPU nodes Ready, labeler daemonset redeployed and labeled nodes. Autoscaler scaled up pods. Re-enabling prune on cluster-ops now.

lucy: re-enabled prune and bumped timeout persisted. I'll follow for next prune wave to ensure no regressions.

dena: follow-up action: add a canary delay for ArgoCD prune for any app that manages cluster-critical DS/DS+StatefulSets (30m post node creation). I'll open a small RFC.

jamie: thanks all. documenting steps in infra runbook and adding an automated check to avoid prune during concurrent terraform applies. :thumbsup:
